raw.name: Mech Sword

dictionary.lore: A long sword made using techniques unlike those found in Grand Gaia. The sword is equipped with a special device that, when activated, completely envelopes both the sword and the user in a thin membrane. This rare item is desired by legions of swordsman as it is said that the abilities of those wrapped in this membrane are greatly increased.
